votes.sql:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN product_price < 100 THEN 'budget'
        WHEN product_price <= 500 THEN 'standard'
        ELSE 'premium'
    END AS price_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM Products
GROUP BY price_tier;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN product_price < 200 THEN 'Budget'
        WHEN product_price >= 200 AND product_price <= 500 THEN 'Standard'
        ELSE 'Premium'
    END AS price_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM Products
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN product_price < 200 THEN 'Budget'
        WHEN product_price >= 200 AND product_price <= 500 THEN 'Standard'
        ELSE 'Premium'
    END

SELECT CASE WHEN product_price < 200 THEN 'budget' WHEN product_price BETWEEN 200 AND 800 THEN 'standard' ELSE 'premium' END AS price_tier, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM "Products" GROUP BY price_tier ORDER BY price_tier;

SELECT c.customer_id,
       c.customer_first_name,
       c.customer_last_name,
       SUM(p.product_price) AS total_purchase_value,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_frequency
FROM Customers c
JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
HAVING SUM(p.product_price) >= :min_total_purchase
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= :min_order_count;

           SUM(p.product_price) AS total_spent,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM "Customers" c
    JOIN "Orders" o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN "Order_Items" oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN "Products" p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT c.customer_first_name,
       c.customer_last_name
FROM customer_stats cs
JOIN "Customers" c ON c.customer_id = cs.customer_id
WHERE cs.total_spent > 1000
  AND cs.order_count > 3;

WITH shipment_info AS (
        SELECT s.shipment_id,
               o.date_order_placed AS order_date,
               s.shipment_date,
               MAX(CASE WHEN p.product_price > 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_risk_flag
        FROM Shipments s
        JOIN Orders o ON s.order_id = o.order_id
        JOIN Shipment_Items si ON s.shipment_id = si.shipment_id
        JOIN Order_Items oi ON si.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
        JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
        GROUP BY s.shipment_id, o.date_order_placed, s.shipment_date
),
high_risk_shipments AS (
        SELECT shipment_id,
               date(order_date) AS start_date,
               date(shipment_date) AS end_date
        FROM shipment_info
        WHERE high_risk_flag = 1
),
recursive_days AS (
        -- seed row for each shipment
        SELECT shipment_id,
               start_date AS cur_date,
               end_date
        FROM high_risk_shipments
        UNION ALL
        -- generate next day until we pass the end date
        SELECT rd.shipment_id,
               date(rd.cur_date, '+1 day') AS cur_date,
               rd.end_date
        FROM recursive_days rd
        WHERE rd.cur_date < rd.end_date
),
weekday_counts AS (
        SELECT shipment_id,
               SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%w', cur_date) NOT IN ('0','6') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS business_days
        FROM recursive_days
        GROUP BY shipment_id
)
SELECT AVG(business_days) AS average_business_days
FROM weekday_counts;

votes.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM Products
    WHERE product_id = 8
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.product_id
    FROM Products p
    JOIN hierarchy h ON p.parent_product_id = h.product_id
)
SELECT c.country,
       SUM(p.product_price) AS total_revenue
FROM hierarchy h
JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = h.product_id
JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = h.product_id
GROUP BY c.country;

WITH RECURSIVE product_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_price
    FROM Products
    WHERE product_id = 8
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT p.product_id, p.product_price
    FROM Products p
    INNER JOIN product_hierarchy ph ON p.parent_product_id = ph.product_id
)
SELECT 
    SUM(ph.product_price) AS total_revenue
FROM product_hierarchy ph
JOIN Order_Items oi ON ph.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id;

WITH RECURSIVE "product_tree" AS (
    SELECT "product_id" FROM "Products" WHERE "product_id" = 8
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p."product_id" FROM "Products" p
    JOIN "product_tree" pt ON p."parent_product_id" = pt."product_id"
),
"revenue_data" AS (
    SELECT
        p."product_price",
        c."country"
    FROM "Order_Items" oi
    JOIN "product_tree" pt ON oi."product_id" = pt."product_id"
    JOIN "Products" p ON oi."product_id" = p."product_id"
    JOIN "Orders" o ON oi."order_id" = o."order_id"
    JOIN "Customers" c ON o."customer_id" = c."customer_id"
)
SELECT
    SUM("product_price" * (1 + CASE
        WHEN "country" = 'USA' THEN 0.08
        WHEN "country" = 'Palau' THEN 0.00
        WHEN "country" = 'Moldova' THEN 0.20
        WHEN "country" = 'Saint Vincent and the Grenadines' THEN 0.15
        WHEN "country" = 'South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands' THEN 0.00
        ELSE 0.00
    END)) AS "total_revenue_including_tax"
FROM "revenue_data";

WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        ((CAST(strftime('%m', o.date_order_placed) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3) + 1 AS quarter,
        p.product_price AS usd_price
    FROM Orders o
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', o.date_order_placed) = '2021'
),
quarter_usd AS (
    SELECT quarter, SUM(usd_price) AS total_usd
    FROM order_revenue
    GROUP BY quarter
),
quarter_rate AS (
    SELECT
        ((CAST(strftime('%m', date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3) + 1 AS quarter,
        AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM Exchange_Rates
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2021'
    GROUP BY quarter
),
quarter_eur AS (
    SELECT
        q.quarter,
        q.total_usd * r.avg_rate AS total_eur
    FROM quarter_usd q
    JOIN quarter_rate r ON q.quarter = r.quarter
)
SELECT
    quarter,
    total_eur,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_eur DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM quarter_eur
ORDER BY revenue_rank;

WITH SalesData AS (
    SELECT 
        i.invoice_number,
        i.invoice_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN strftime('%m', i.invoice_date) BETWEEN '01' AND '03' THEN 1
            WHEN strftime('%m', i.invoice_date) BETWEEN '04' AND '06' THEN 2
            WHEN strftime('%m', i.invoice_date) BETWEEN '07' AND '09' THEN 3
            WHEN strftime('%m', i.invoice_date) BETWEEN '10' AND '12' THEN 4
        END AS quarter_num,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS revenue_usd
    FROM Invoices i
    INNER JOIN Shipments s ON i.invoice_number = s.invoice_number
    INNER JOIN Shipment_Items si ON s.shipment_id = si.shipment_id
    INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON si.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
    INNER JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', i.invoice_date) = '2021'
    GROUP BY i.invoice_number, i.invoice_date
),
QuarterlyRevenue AS (
    SELECT 
        quarter_num,
        CASE quarter_num 
            WHEN 1 THEN 'Q1'
            WHEN 2 THEN 'Q2'
            WHEN 3 THEN 'Q3'
            WHEN 4 THEN 'Q4'
        END AS quarter,
        SUM(revenue_usd) AS total_revenue_usd,
        SUM(revenue_usd) * 0.85 AS total_revenue_eur
    FROM SalesData
    GROUP BY quarter_num
)
SELECT 
    quarter,
    ROUND(total_revenue_eur, 2) AS total_sales_revenue_euros,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue_eur DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM QuarterlyRevenue
WHERE quarter IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY revenue_rank ASC

WITH order_items_2021 AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_price,
        strftime('%Y', o.date_order_placed) AS yr,
        (CAST((strftime('%m', o.date_order_placed) - 1) / 3 AS INTEGER) + 1) AS qtr
    FROM Orders o
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', o.date_order_placed) = '2021'
),
quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT
        qtr AS quarter,
        yr AS year,
        SUM(product_price) AS total_usd
    FROM order_items_2021
    GROUP BY qtr, yr
)
SELECT
    qs.quarter,
    qs.total_usd * er.avg_rate AS total_sales_revenue_euros,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY qs.total_usd * er.avg_rate DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM quarter_sales qs
JOIN ExchangeRates er ON qs.year = er.year AND qs.quarter = er.quarter
ORDER BY revenue_rank;

votes.sql:
WITH exchange_rate AS (SELECT 0.9 AS rate) -- replace 0.9 with today’s USD‑to‑EUR rate
SELECT 
    c.customer_first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(c.customer_middle_initial || ' ', '') || c.customer_last_name AS full_name,
    ROUND(SUM(p.product_price * (SELECT rate FROM exchange_rate)), 2) AS total_spent_eur
FROM Customers c
JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING SUM(p.product_price * (SELECT rate FROM exchange_rate)) > 2000
ORDER BY total_spent_eur DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           SUM(p.product_price) AS total_spent
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT customer_id
FROM customer_spending
WHERE total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM customer_spending);

SELECT c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status_code NOT IN ('Cancelled') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS total_spent
    FROM "Customers" c
    JOIN "Orders" o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN "Order_Items" oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN "Products" p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
avg_total AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_spent) AS avg_spent FROM customer_totals
)
SELECT
    c.customer_first_name || ' ' ||
    CASE WHEN c.customer_middle_initial IS NOT NULL THEN c.customer_middle_initial || ' ' ELSE '' END ||
    c.customer_last_name AS customer_name
FROM customer_totals ct
JOIN "Customers" c ON c.customer_id = ct.customer_id
CROSS JOIN avg_total at
WHERE ct.total_spent > at.avg_spent;

votes.sql:
SELECT 
    c.customer_first_name || COALESCE(' ' || c.customer_middle_initial || '.', '') || ' ' || c.customer_last_name AS name,
    c.email_address,
    CASE 
        WHEN cs.total_spent >= 2000 THEN 'Gold'
        WHEN cs.total_spent >= 1500 THEN 'Silver'
        ELSE 'Bronze'
    END AS membership
FROM (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS total_spent
    FROM "Orders" o
    JOIN "Order_Items" oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN "Products" p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.date_order_placed >= date('now', '-12 months')
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
    HAVING total_spent > 1000
) cs
JOIN "Customers" c ON c.customer_id = cs.customer_id
ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC;

SELECT c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, c.email_address FROM Customers c INNER JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.date_order_placed >= datetime('now', '-12 months') GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING SUM(p.product_price) > 1000

WITH max_date AS (SELECT MAX(date_order_placed) AS max_dt FROM Orders),
filtered AS (
 SELECT c.customer_id,
        c.customer_first_name || ' ' || c.customer_last_name AS customer_name,
        c.email_address,
        SUM(p.product_price) AS total_spent
 FROM Customers c
 JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
 JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
 JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
 WHERE o.date_order_placed >= (SELECT date(max_dt, '-12 months') FROM max_date)
 GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, c.email_address
)
SELECT customer_name,
       email_address,
       CASE
         WHEN total_spent > 1000 THEN 'Gold'
         WHEN total_spent >= 500 THEN 'Silver'
         ELSE 'Bronze'
       END AS loyalty_tier
FROM filtered
WHERE total_spent > 1000;

WITH customer_scores AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           c.customer_first_name,
           c.customer_last_name,
           c.email_address,
           SUM(p.product_price *
               CASE WHEN o.date_order_placed >= DATE('now','-30 day') THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
              ) AS total_score
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customer_Payment_Methods pm ON c.customer_id = pm.customer_id
    JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE c.country = 'USA'
      AND pm.payment_method_code = 'Direct Debit'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT customer_first_name,
       customer_last_name,
       email_address
FROM customer_scores
WHERE total_score > (SELECT AVG(total_score) FROM customer_scores)
ORDER BY total_score DESC;

WITH recent_cutoff AS (
    SELECT DATE(MAX(date_order_placed), '-6 months') AS cutoff
    FROM Orders
),
order_values AS (
    SELECT o.order_id,
           o.customer_id,
           o.date_order_placed,
           SUM(p.product_price) AS order_value
    FROM Orders o
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.date_order_placed
),
scored AS (
    SELECT ov.customer_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(ov.date_order_placed) >= (SELECT cutoff FROM recent_cutoff)
                    THEN 2 * ov.order_value
                    ELSE ov.order_value END) AS score
    FROM order_values ov
    GROUP BY ov.customer_id
),
customer_filtered AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           c.customer_first_name,
           c.customer_last_name,
           c.email_address
    FROM Customers c
    JOIN Customer_Payment_Methods cpm ON cpm.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE c.country = 'USA'
      AND cpm.payment_method_code = 'Direct Debit'
)
SELECT cf.customer_first_name,
       cf.customer_last_name,
       cf.email_address
FROM customer_filtered cf
JOIN scored s ON cf.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.score > (SELECT AVG(score) FROM scored)
ORDER BY s.score DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           SUM(p.product_price) AS total_price
    FROM Orders o
    JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.order_status_code = 'Delivered'
      AND o.date_order_placed >= datetime('now','-6 months')
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
order_counts AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
    FROM Orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    TRIM(c.customer_first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(c.customer_middle_initial || ' ', '') || c.customer_last_name) AS customer_name,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(oc.order_cnt,0) > 3
         THEN ot.total_price * 0.95
         ELSE ot.total_price
    END AS total_euros_spent,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(oc.order_cnt,0) > 3
                      THEN ot.total_price * 0.95
                      ELSE ot.total_price
                 END DESC
    ) AS rank
FROM order_totals ot
JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = ot.customer_id
LEFT JOIN order_counts oc ON oc.customer_id = ot.customer_id
ORDER BY total_euros_spent DESC;

WITH OrderCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) as order_count
    FROM Orders
    WHERE order_status_code = 'Delivered'
    AND date_order_placed >= date('now', '-6 months')
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
CustomerSpending AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_first_name,
        c.customer_last_name,
        SUM(
            p.product_price * CASE 
                WHEN oc.order_count > 3 THEN 0.95 
                ELSE 1.0 
            END
        ) AS total_spent
    FROM Customers c
    INNER JOIN OrderCounts oc ON c.customer_id = oc.customer_id
    INNER JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    INNER JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.order_status_code = 'Delivered'
    AND o.date_order_placed >= date('now', '-6 months')
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, oc.order_count
)
SELECT 
    customer_first_name || ' ' || customer_last_name AS customer_name,
    ROUND(total_spent, 2) AS total_spent,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS rank
FROM CustomerSpending
ORDER BY rank ASC;

WITH max_date AS (SELECT MAX(date_order_placed) AS max_dt FROM Orders),
     recent_orders AS (
         SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id
         FROM Orders o, max_date md
         WHERE o.date_order_placed >= date(md.max_dt, '-6 months')
     ),
     order_counts AS (
         SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
         FROM recent_orders
         GROUP BY customer_id
     ),
     delivered_spend AS (
         SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(p.product_price) AS total_spent
         FROM Order_Items oi
         JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
         JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
         JOIN max_date md ON 1=1
         WHERE o.order_status_code = 'Delivered'
           AND o.date_order_placed >= date(md.max_dt, '-6 months')
         GROUP BY o.customer_id
     ),
     customer_info AS (
         SELECT c.customer_id,
                TRIM(c.customer_first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(c.customer_middle_initial, '') || ' ' || c.customer_last_name) AS customer_name
         FROM Customers c
     )
SELECT ci.customer_name,
       ROUND(COALESCE(ds.total_spent, 0) * CASE WHEN COALESCE(oc.order_cnt, 0) > 3 THEN 0.95 ELSE 1.0 END, 2) AS total_euros_spent,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ds.total_spent, 0) * CASE WHEN COALESCE(oc.order_cnt, 0) > 3 THEN 0.95 ELSE 1.0 END DESC) AS rank
FROM customer_info ci
LEFT JOIN delivered_spend ds ON ci.customer_id = ds.customer_id
LEFT JOIN order_counts oc ON ci.customer_id = oc.customer_id
WHERE COALESCE(ds.total_spent, 0) > 0
ORDER BY total_euros_spent DESC;

WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt,
    SUM(p.product_price) AS total_purchase
  FROM Orders o
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
)

  c.customer_id,
  CASE
    WHEN ct.total_purchase >= 2000 AND ct.order_cnt >= 10 THEN 'Platinum'
    WHEN ct.total_purchase >= 1000 AND ct.order_cnt >= 5 THEN 'Gold'
    WHEN ct.total_purchase >= 500 AND ct.order_cnt >= 2 THEN 'Silver'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS tier
FROM customer_totals ct
JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = ct.customer_id
WHERE tier IS NOT NULL;

WITH cust_stats AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.customer_first_name,
        c.customer_last_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(p.product_price), 0) AS total_purchase,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_freq
    FROM Customers c
    LEFT JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    LEFT JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        customer_first_name,
        customer_last_name,
        total_purchase,
        order_freq,
        (total_purchase + order_freq) AS score,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY (total_purchase + order_freq) DESC) AS ntile
    FROM cust_stats
)
SELECT
    customer_first_name || ' ' || customer_last_name AS customer_name,
    CASE ntile
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Platinum'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Gold'
        ELSE 'Silver'
    END AS loyalty_tier
FROM scored
ORDER BY loyalty_tier, customer_name;
